verdict.rationale: Live multi-session updates are a fair question for a collaborative work-management app, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no evidence that Asana's own UI pushes teammates' changes to open sessions without a refresh. Webhooks that notify external apps of changes are a developer building block, and the third-party 'real-time 2-way sync' integrations are a different capability, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
